text_block_list.text:
Огури Кэп garners attention as the Hero
from the
Countryside.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик, who will be going up
against Oguri
Cap in the autumn Tenno
Sho, has become a
villain in the eyes of
the public.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Embracing the role, she decides to run
the race as
the villain, declaring her
intention to defeat
Oguri Cap.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
